claim: Apple reports no less than $81.1B in revenue for Q1 2025
summary: Apple's reported revenue for Q1 2025 was well above $81.1B under either fiscal or calendar definition (fiscal Q1 2025 ~$124.3B; calendar Q1 2025 ~$95.4B), so the 'no less than $81.1B' threshold is met.
